dog.description_text:
🐶 Age: Approximately 3 months old
🐾 Breed: Dachshund/Lab Mix
💕 Personality: Sweet, playful, and absolutely adorable!
Ella is a gorgeous little pup with a heart full of love and a serious obsession with TOYS! 🧸🎾 If it's a toy, Ella wants to play with it! She doesn't discriminate — every toy is her favorite!
This sweet girl has been exposed to both dogs and cats and is learning all the important things that come with being a puppy.
And let's talk about how SMART she is! 🌟
🐾 Crate trained!
🐾 Potty training is going GREAT!
🐾 Already mastered the doggy door!
🐾 Goes outside to do her business like a big girl!
dog.name: Ella
